exact_future_input.physical_binding: Future driver must authenticate the exact prior proof and its original decimal-string physical identity, then two full held/named reads plus later physical/SHA bookends. Copied inode identity is separate from container-source authority.

supported_domain.input: Exact immutable bytes, 64 through 262144 inclusive; ELF64, little-endian, identification/header version CURRENT, ET_DYN, exact standard64/56/64-byte Ehdr/Phdr/Shdr widths.
supported_domain.tables: Required nonempty standard-numbered program and section tables after the ELF header, required section-name table, bounded full spans. Extended phnum/shnum/shstrndx and absent tables refuse explicitly. This is a narrow support domain, not a claim those general ELF representations are invalid.
supported_domain.undefined_and_nonfilebacked: PT_NULL and SHT_NULL payload fields are retained raw without file-span requirements. SHT_NOBITS size/offset are retained raw without allocation or treating them as file bytes. No conceptual memsz allocation occurs.
supported_domain.loads: File-backed bounds, filesz no greater than memsz, nonwrapping virtual range, ascending virtual addresses, power-of-two alignment and offset/address congruence.
supported_domain.dynamic: Exactly one PT_DYNAMIC and matching linked SHT_DYNAMIC. Every complete slot is retained in order; semantics end at the first DT_NULL, whose value is ignored. Later slots remain raw with inactive labels. Signed tags and unsigned values remain exact decimal strings.
supported_domain.strings: Exactly one active DT_STRTAB and DT_STRSZ, positive size, whole nonwrapping range maps to exactly one PT_LOAD using filesz rather than memsz. Linked SHT_STRTAB span must match. Tables start/end in NUL; every selected index terminates inside its table. Arbitrary bytes are hex, no UTF8 assumptions. String length over4096 refuses; no truncation.
supported_domain.declarations: Retain all ordered active DT_NEEDED/SONAME/RPATH/RUNPATH string declarations, including repeated NEEDED and substring/empty-string indices. Preserve unknown dynamic tags without interpreting them. No SONAME/path-to-library resolution.
supported_domain.resource_work: One16MiB budget covers every hashed byte span, all record/table/payload/string-table hashes and the full-input digest. Each repeated span is charged again before hashing. A refused input returns no partial accepted document.

implementation_separation.primary: parse-callback-elf-data-v1-2026-10-18.py uses struct.unpack_from and standard-width format strings.
implementation_separation.independent: fold-callback-elf-data-v1-2026-10-18.py uses explicit widths, cursor advancement, int.from_bytes, separately written bounds and string cursor. It never imports or invokes the primary decoder.
implementation_separation.shared: Only the declared schema, constants and refusal categories are shared. Both are new stdlib operational controls; neither has IO or native/payload imports. Equality alone cannot exclude a shared interpretation error, so synthetic known-value assertions are separate from full-output parity.

actual_driver_and_independent_fold_requi: New bounded source-pinned drivers, source-staging, invocation and finite resource/ownership controls must be prepared and independently reviewed BEFORE use; none exists in this checkpoint.
Use only the exact retained callback and prior proof as DATA. No Docker, new cp/HEAD, container start/create/exec/load, package imports, dlopen, ldd, readelf or other19 native body reads.

Retain complete ordered headers, PH/SH/dynamic records, raw-record hex and full payload/span SHA; split full outputs into bounded pages by actual encoded byte size as well as record count. No truncation or output cap exception.

Independent driver must authenticate every page/summary/source/prior input with two full reads/SHA/held and named decimal physical identity and later bookends, reconstruct from the authenticated binary independently, and compare every field/record/order/raw span, not only aggregate counts.
Exclusive new output/tool/review roots, bounded files/stdout/stderr, files then root/parent fsync/readback; preserve refusal roots. No crash/durability assertion without actual evidence.
